# Install

See the [guide](/docs/guides/guide#step-two), the [same guide](./guides/guide),
the [placeholder](/docs/guides/stub), [the overview](/docs) and
[this page's notes](#notes). The agent README is
[here](https://github.com/defilantech/LLMKube/blob/main/deployment/README.md#configuration).

Inline code such as `--model <name>` on one line is fine, and so is a fenced block:

```bash
llmkube cache clear --model <name>
echo {not an expression}
```

A latency under 1s, and `{braces}` and `a < b` in code are fine.
